messages:
maria: Drafting a focused PRD for observability governance + rollout risks for Console. Putting main ask here so we can align: need final launch criteria, retention guardrails, and a minimal canary plan for the first customer waves.

maria: TL;DR — goal is to ship a defensible default for telemetry retention + safe fallback behavior that meets compliance asks and keeps cost predictable for Hosted users. Also propose a 2-week canary with 5 customers before wide enable.

maria: Acceptance checklist (WIP):
```
- [ ] Defined retention tiers (14d, 90d, 365d) and billing mapping
- [ ] UI to surface current retention and warnings for high-volume projects
- [ ] Export/purge APIs with RBAC + audit log entries
- [ ] Tracing and span sampling policy defaults + override hooks
- [ ] Canary plan + rollback criteria (errors > 2%, token cost > 15% over baseline, p95 latency regressions)
- [ ] E2E tests for dashboard render at scale (100k series)
```

kevin: Quick q — are retention tiers per-organization or per-project? Customers keep asking for per-route/per-project granularity.

maria: Prefer per-project defaults with org-level override. That keeps ops simple but lets large customers opt into custom tiers.

ash: +1 to per-project. Also need clear soft-limits and hard-limits in UI. Soft-limit gives warning, hard-limit blocks ingest with clear error code and docs link.

sophia: For rollback criteria — suggest adding data loss/consistency checks. If purge/export ops fail, we must auto-disable the feature and page ops.

jordan: Quick note on billing mapping: mapping to existing cost buckets (ingest tokens, storage GB-month) is needed. We should include sample math in the PRD. Heavier retention = linear storage + small index cost.

maria: Adding to PRD: example pricing SKU lines and a simple estimator in UI.

kevin: Edge case — what about private deployments (VPC/on-prem)? They want 100% control; we should list 'opt-out' flow and a default 'no telemetry shipped to hosted control plane' setting for Private customers.

dev-bot: Deploy pipeline: prd/observability/retention-rfc v1 pushed to /docs (CI ID: 7421).

maria: Canary plan draft:
- Week 0: internal QA + perf tests
- Week 1: 2 small customers (non-critical) + 1 medium (opt-in) — monitor error rate, p95 latency, cost uplift
- Week 2: expand to 5 customers, run billing sim on historical traffic
Rollback triggers: error rate > 2% sustained 30m, p99 latency regression > 300ms, unexpected storage growth > 25% week-over-week

ash: For monitoring, add an automated regression alert tied to a known prompt set (we already have evaluation harness). If model of insights pipelines regresses, trigger rollback.

maria: UX flows: need a small modal explaining retention impact when changing tiers (cost + query performance + export latency). Also add a 'preview cost' before apply.

kevin: Data residency question — we must surface region constraints in the UI when selecting retention for customers in EU. Might require legal signoff.

sophia: Acceptance criteria addendum: docs linked in-app, KMS key selection for private retention exports, audit log entry for every retention change.

jordan: Perf engineering note — synthetic test: render dashboard with 250k timeseries at 30s resolution. If rendering > 2s, we need incremental rendering or pagination.

maria: Action items: @kevin to finalize billing mapping by EOD Friday; @ash to write canary runbook and rollback playbook; @sophia to write compliance/residency checklist; @jordan to own perf test harness. I'll consolidate into PRD v1.1 and drop link here. :calendar: :eyes:

kevin: Ack, will push numbers.

ash: Will start runbook draft, link by Monday.

sophia: I'll sync with legal about residency wording, expect a short note by Monday.

jordan: Starting perf harness job now, I'll report back with baselines.

maria: Thanks — aim to freeze launch criteria next Wed so eng can schedule the release. If anyone has specific launch blockers, drop them here.

kevin: One more potential blocker: migration strategy for customers currently on unlimited retention (old pilot). Need a grace period and migration email templates.

maria: Good catch. Add migration plan + communication templates to PRD.

ash: Can we add an emergency escape hatch: manual toggle at org level that forces retention back to previous behavior for customers in the canary? Ops needs an audit trail.

maria: Yes — ops toggle + audit logs = included.

dev-bot: Reminder: Meeting scheduled 2051238000 (UTC) — Observability PRD sync.

maria: Final note: keeping scope intentionally tight. We are not doing a full query-export UI in v1 — only a retention selector, preview cost, and export/purge API surface. Anything else goes to v2. :+1:
